plans.name: Plus plan (includes AI-powered Receptionist), no commitment

notes: AI Receptionist is a $29/mo add-on to a Jobber plan (Core starts at $29/mo); it is included in Plus ($499/mo no commitment for 5 users, $399/mo billed annually). Included minutes/calls not stated.

free_trial.text: For 14 days you get full access to all of Jobber’s features on the Grow plan
